keyEvents.text: Cameron Pring (Bristol City) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay in match because of an injury Issa Kaboré (Wrexham).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Goal! Bristol City 0, Wrexham 1. Joe Worrall (Wrexham) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Benjamin Whiteman with a cross following a corner.
Delay in match because of an injury Luke McNally (Bristol City).
Substitution, Bristol City. Rob Dickie replaces Luke McNally because of an injury.
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Delay in match (Bristol City).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Bailey Cadamarteri (Wrexham) is shown the yellow card.
Rob Atkinson (Bristol City) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
First Half ends, Bristol City 0, Wrexham 1.
Goal! Bristol City 1, Wrexham 1. Cameron Pring (Bristol City) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner.
George Thomason (Wrexham) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Wrexham. Kieffer Moore replaces Bailey Cadamarteri.
Substitution, Wrexham. Oliver Rathbone replaces Lewis O'Brien.
Substitution, Wrexham. Danny Imray replaces Issa Kaboré.
Substitution, Bristol City. Tomi Horvat replaces Lorent Tolaj.
Substitution, Bristol City. Joe Williams replaces Adam Randell.
Substitution, Bristol City. Gibson Yah replaces Jason Knight.
Substitution, Bristol City. Yu Hirakawa replaces Jed Wallace.
Scott Twine (Bristol City) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Wrexham. Matty James replaces George Dobson.
Substitution, Wrexham. Ben Sheaf replaces Benjamin Whiteman.
Second Half ends, Bristol City 1, Wrexham 1.
